minute_contract.earliest_action: next completed bar open; never inside signal bar t
minute_contract.same_minute_order: unresolved; multiple triggers are simultaneous clusters excluded from strict leadership
minute_contract.missing_or_abnormal_session: fail closed via exact 241-bar CY-008 hard-valid snapshot binding

universe.liquidity: prior 20 stock-session mean daily amount >= CNY 50,000,000 with all 20 observations
universe.reason_for_event_minutes: five completed prior continuous minutes and ten future continuous minutes without crossing lunch or close

phase_a.stock_minute_return: log(close_t / close_t-1), where 09:31 uses the completed 09:30 auction close
phase_a.abnormal_move: stock minute return minus equal-weight mean return of all other eligible PIT-industry constituents at the same minute

requirements: exactly one constituent at or above threshold
leader close at least one CNY0.01 tick below historical upper-limit price
leader_event.overlap: the first threshold occurrence in an industry-day must be strict; a preceding simultaneous cluster disqualifies that industry-day

phase_a.simultaneous_cluster: two or more constituents at or above the same frozen threshold in the same minute; excluded from strict event and control pools
peer_metrics: median and mean cumulative peer return minus cumulative cross-sectional market-median minute return
fraction of peers with positive cumulative raw return
positive-minute breadth expansion versus minute t
fraction of peers with any later abnormal-minute trigger at the frozen 1% threshold

matched_control.candidate: same PIT industry and exact minute index on one of the prior 60 market sessions, with zero threshold triggers at or before that minute on the control industry-day; exclude the contemporaneous maximum-abnormal pseudo-leader
matched_control.distance: equal-weight squared standardized distance; scales estimated only from that strictly historical candidate pool with floors [0.0005,0.0005,0.05,0.25] in listed state order; ties prefer the most recent prior date then pseudo-leader symbol

phase_a.negative_control: matched event-minus-control peer abnormal return during t-3 through t-1; the primary future effect must exceed this reverse-time association

characteristics: same-minute volume surge versus prior-20 same-clock median
phase_b_locked.maximum_bundle: one equal-rank bundle only if at least two individual characteristics add independently

phase_c_locked.portfolio_replays: at most one action after frozen candidate gate
phase_c_locked.execution: earliest next-bar open, historical limit/suspension rules, transaction costs, and T+1; classify implementation conflict if signal half-life is shorter than legal holding

prohibited: future industry breadth or end-of-day winner leader definition
threshold, horizon, control, or sign search
Phase B/C access without Phase-A authorization
OOS, independent-confirmation, validation, live, or production claims
